title: MPI Communication Performance on AMD MI300A: Microbenchmarks and Applications
problem: AMD MI300A integrates CPU and GPU chiplets with shared HBM3; traditional host-device boundary assumptions invalidated; little guidance on MPI library behavior on this novel architecture
motivation: Early MI300A deployments lack performance characterization; need practical guidance for MPI optimization on APU architectures
method: Comparative study of MVAPICH-Plus, Open MPI, MPICH, and Cray MPICH on MI300A APU nodes; microbenchmark analysis (point-to-point, collectives, scaling); application validation with OpenFOAM and LLM distributed training
key_novelty: First comprehensive MPI performance characterization on AMD MI300A APU architecture with shared memory hierarchy insights
contributions: Point-to-point performance analysis on CPU and GPU buffers
Application-level performance validation with HPC and ML workloads
limitations: Abstract does not provide specific performance numbers or detailed bottleneck analysis
